#!/usr/bin/env bun
// Generated by crewhaus. DO NOT EDIT.
// Source spec: "pin-voice" (target: voice, ir version: 0, file: daemon.ts)
import { existsSync, readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { openAuditLog } from "@crewhaus/audit-log";
import { createControlPlane } from "@crewhaus/gateway-protocol/control";
import { runOneCall } from "./voice-loop.js";

let __callInFlight = false;

function emit(event: Record<string, unknown>): void {
  process.stdout.write(`${JSON.stringify(event)}\n`);
}

function loadPcm(path: string): Int16Array {
  if (!existsSync(path)) {
    throw new Error("[voice-daemon] PCM file not found: " + path);
  }
  const buf = readFileSync(path);
  // raw PCM 16-bit little-endian mono. Align onto a fresh ArrayBuffer
  // because Buffer's underlying buffer can have an unaligned offset.
  const aligned = new ArrayBuffer(buf.byteLength);
  new Uint8Array(aligned).set(buf);
  return new Int16Array(aligned);
}

async function smokeMode(pcmPath: string): Promise<void> {
  emit({ kind: "smoke_start", pcmPath });
  const pcm = loadPcm(pcmPath);
  emit({ kind: "smoke_pcm_loaded", samples: pcm.length });
  __callInFlight = true;
  try {
    await runOneCall({
      inboundPcm: pcm,
      listener: (ev) => emit({ kind: "voice_event", event: ev }),
    });
  } finally {
    __callInFlight = false;
  }
  emit({ kind: "smoke_done" });
}

async function main(): Promise<void> {
  // control.v1 — the harness-wide hash-chained audit log every control call
  // appends a `gateway_request` record to. CREWHAUS_SECURITY_AUDIT=0 opts out.
  const __controlAudit =
    process.env["CREWHAUS_SECURITY_AUDIT"] === "0"
      ? undefined
      : await openAuditLog({ rootDir: `${process.cwd()}/.crewhaus/audit` });
  // crewhaus.control.v1 — the supervisor-facing control plane (§ dedicated
  // port from CREWHAUS_CONTROL_PORT, bearer from CREWHAUS_CONTROL_TOKEN or a
  // boot-minted .crewhaus/run/control-token). Unset port ⇒ no socket opens.
  const __control = createControlPlane({
    name: "pin-voice",
    target: "voice",
    audit: async (__rec) => {
      const __log = __controlAudit;
      if (__log !== undefined) await __log.append(__rec);
    },
  });
  __control.onDrain(async () => {
    emit({ kind: "drain_requested", via: "control.v1" });
    while (__callInFlight) await new Promise((__r) => setTimeout(__r, 100));
  });
  await __control.start();
  const args = process.argv.slice(2);
  const smokeIdx = args.indexOf("--smoke");
  if (smokeIdx !== -1 && smokeIdx + 1 < args.length) {
    await smokeMode(args[smokeIdx + 1]!);
    __control.counters.turns++;
    await __control.stop();
    return;
  }
  await __control.stop();
  process.stderr.write(
    "[voice-daemon] no --smoke <pcm-path> provided. v0 ships the headless smoke path; the WebRTC + telephony bridge lands in a follow-up.\n",
  );
  process.exit(2);
}

main().catch((err) => {
  process.stderr.write(`[voice-daemon] fatal: ${(err as Error).message}\n`);
  process.exit(1);
});
